name: Account Deletion
title11: How do I delete my Account.
answer:
• If you wish to delete your account, please follow these steps:
    - Open the app and go to your Profile section.
    - Scroll down and tap on Account Settings.
    - Select Delete Account.
    - Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the process.
    Note: After deleting your account, please avoid logging into the Dostt app for 30 days. If you log in during this period, your account will be restored with your previous details.

title11: Why am I not able to hear anything on call
answer:

name: Video Issue
title11: Why is the video not working during my call ?
answer:
As an app feature, if your face or the Listener’s face is not in front of the phone, the camera feed is automatically turned off for both of you. Additionally, a weak internet connection can affect video quality.

If you believe this is a technical issue, please raise a support ticket and provide a detailed description of the problem, such as no video, blurred video, distorted video, or lagging video.

Our team will review your case and assist in resolving it promptly."

name: App Related Issue
title11: App freezes or closes unexpectedly, how can I fix it ?
answer:
Please make sure you are using the latest version of the app. To update the app, follow these steps :

For Android:

1.  Open the Google Play Store.
2.  Search for Dostt.
3.  Tap Update if an update is available.

For iOS:

1.  Open the App Store.
2.  Tap your profile icon at the top right.
3.  Scroll to see pending updates and release notes.
4.  Tap Update next to Dostt if an update is available.

If the issue persists after updating, please raise a support ticket by clicking the link below and provide all the details of exactly what is happening.

Our team will review your case and assist you promptly.

name: OTP
title11: I shared my OTP with some person and amount is withdrawal from my account
answer:
For your safety and security, you should never share your OTP (One-Time Password) or any other sensitive account information with anyone — including friends, family, or strangers. OTPs are strictly personal and are meant to verify your identity during transactions.

If an OTP is shared with someone else and a transaction occurs as a result, we are not liable for any loss incurred. Please note that all withdrawals and transactions using a shared OTP are considered authorized by the account holder, and we cannot reverse them.

name: Dostt was Rude
title11: What should I do if a Listener is rude?
answer:
Thank you for reporting this issue and helping us improve the in-app experience. If you encountered a rude Listener, you can report them by following these steps:

- Go to the session for which Listener was rude.
- Tap the three dots on the right side of the call.
- Select Report User.
- Choose the appropriate reason for your report.

Our Trust and Safety team will review the case and take appropriate action within 24–48 hours.

name: Asking for Personal Info
title11: What should I do if a Listener asks for my personal information ?
answer:
We would like to clarify that our platform never asks customers to share sensitive personal information, such as phone numbers, social media IDs (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, etc.), passwords, OTPs, or payment details over calls or messages.

For your safety, please do not share any such information, as it can put your account and personal data at risk of misuse.

If someone requests this information from you via call or message, report it immediately 
- Go to the session for which Listener was asking for personal Information.
- Tap the three dots on the right side of the call.
- Select Report User.
- Choose the appropriate reason for your report. Our team will investigate the issue and take appropriate action to protect users.

name: Dostt not showing Face
title11: What should I do if a Listener is not showing their face on a video call ?
answer:
If a Listener is not in the camera frame, the video feed is automatically paused.

This feature is designed to protect you from suspicious or unsafe activities. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

If you notice that a Listener is not showing their face for an extended period, you can raise a request.

Our team will review the case and take appropriate action within 24–48 hours.

name: Change UPI Details
title11: How do I add/change my UPI ID ?
answer:
You can add up to 3 UPI IDs in the app for withdrawals. To add a UPI ID, follow these steps :

- Go to the Wallet or Withdrawal section in the app.

If you see an error saying that your PAN is linked with another user, it means that the same PAN has already been used for KYC on our platform.

name: Why is the billed amount higher than my actual conversation?
title11: Why is the billed amount higher than my actual conversation?
answer:
Listeners’ availability depends on several factors, including their login time, activity status, and ongoing sessions. Even if a Listener appears online, they may not be able to answer immediately due to reasons such as:

- They are already engaged in another call.
- They may have temporarily stepped away from their device.
- Time zone differences or personal schedules may limit their availability.
- High demand periods when many users are trying to connect simultaneously.

If you are unable to connect, we recommend:
- Waiting a few minutes and trying the same Listener again.
- Connecting with other available Listeners for a smoother experience.
- Ensuring your internet connection is stable, as connectivity issues can affect call initiation.

We aim to provide a seamless experience, and following these steps usually helps you connect with a Listener without delay.

name: KYC - limit
title11: What is KYC and is this Mandatory ?
answer:
KYC (Know Your Customer) is a verification process used to confirm your identity.

It helps us ensure that your account is secure, transactions are safe, and all payouts comply with government regulations.

Yes, completing KYC is mandatory if your earning is high, for receiving payments on the Dostt app.

Accounts without KYC may face restrictions, including higher TDS deductions or limited access to certain features.

name: Become a Listener
title11: How do I become a Listener on Dostt?
answer:
Becoming a Listener on Dostt is easy!

- Open the Profile section in the Dostt app.
- Tap on Switch to Listener.
- Complete the required steps by:
- Recording your voice sample.
- Uploading a clear photo.
- Filling in the requested details about yourself.
- Submit your application.

Once you've submitted your application, our team will review it and contact you within 24 hours via a phone call to complete the verification process.

While you're waiting, you can continue using Dostt as usual and connect with other Dostts on the platform.

After your verification is complete and your profile is approved, you'll be able to start your journey as a Listener on Dostt.
